Travel paperwork explained midweek
This article covers the basics for travelers
Travel paperwork explained

If you are preparing to fly with a companion animal on Aurelia Skyways, it helps to gather the required papers before you arrive at the airport. The Companion Animal Travel Desk can review the main items, confirm that forms are complete, and help you avoid delays at check-in. Clear paperwork also makes it easier for crews to support your pet during the trip.

Bring any records that show your animal meets the travel rules for the route you booked. That may include health documentation, proof of vaccinations, and any approval that applies to the cabin or the hold. Keep copies in an easy-to-reach folder, since staff may need to see them at more than one point in the journey. If a document is incomplete, the desk will explain what still needs attention so you can correct it before departure.

Some travelers also need extra guidance when plans change. If your booking is adjusted, or if your pet's condition changes before travel, let the Companion Animal Travel Desk know as soon as possible. Early contact gives the department more room to coordinate with the airport team and reduce stress for both you and your animal.

For travelers connecting through different stations, paper requirements may not be the same at every stop. Check that the name on each document matches the booking details and that the information is easy to read. A neat set of documents can help avoid repeated checks and keep the process moving. <<FACT F002>> Keep in mind that local procedures may affect how the paperwork is reviewed at handoff points. <<FACT F022>> If your pet needs special handling, note that on the forms before you travel so the staff can prepare properly.

When you are ready to confirm your documents, bring them to the Companion Animal Travel Desk or reach out through Aurelia Skyways customer support for more help.
